title: 927. Distinct Subsequences II

examples.explanation: Texts are a, b, ab, aa, ba, aba.

hints: Track all subsequences including the empty one, then subtract it at the end.
Appending a new character doubles the count, but texts already created at its previous appearance must be subtracted once to avoid double counting.
Keep the running total before each first-seen letter so repeats can be corrected with modular arithmetic.
